nhook.text: Before you start, know your numbers, like checking the map before a road trip. My free Exposure Calculator is your map.

hi.text: Hi, I'm MTG, Your Digital Architect.

nex.text: Step one: tap an example. The training one is one hundred and fifty dollars of your own, plus the one hundred dollar bonus.

six.text: That's six thousand dollars of exposure.

expo.text: Exposure is the size you trade with, not money you own.

nown.text: Or type your own: your money, any bonus, and the multiplier. Sonic AI's Amplify account uses twenty-four.

ndrag.text: Now drag the price move. One percent on six thousand is sixty dollars, in either direction.

swings.text: Bigger exposure means bigger swings, up and down.

nlines.text: The last two results are your lines to know. With the training example, a two and a half percent move equals your own one hundred and fifty, and about four point two percent equals the whole balance.

nlimit.text: And the loss limit is written down before you start: ten percent of the starting balance, or five percent with a community token.

nrecap.text: So that's the calculator: tap an example or type your own, read your exposure, drag a move, and know your lines before you start.

n_turn2.text: Simple, right? Now it's your turn.

l_ifme.text: If I invited you, go to MTG tribe dot com slash jet up, and tap any Join Jet Up button.

every.text: Invited by someone else? Use their link. This video is for every team, so feel free to share it.

n_save.text: Save this video, so it's here when you need it.

n_share.text: Share it with someone who's ready to start.

n_we.text: We learn best when we teach others.

n_slog.text: It pays to pay attention, and take action.

o_fin.text: Quick reminder: none of this is financial advice.

o_thanks.text: Thank you for tuning in, and for every like, share, and comment.

o_massive.text: And thank yourself for taking massive action today to change your future!

o_best.text: I wish you nothing but the best, because YOU are the best.

o_see.text: See you on the next one.
